My dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939),
Thank you for your note. [Miss Sewell](../persons.html#1301) is coming here to talk the matter over, and sketch our plans next Wednesday week and then I will write again[^1]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: These were plans for [Historical Selections](../books.html#71).
